title: Sports
summary: Following professional leagues closely — the strategy, the narratives, and the analytics underneath.

blocks.content:
## The game behind the game

I've followed sports closely since I was a kid, but what holds my attention now is less about the scoreboard and more about the decisions underneath it — roster construction, in-game adjustments, the relationship between analytics and instinct.

## Basketball

NBA is my main sport. I follow team-building strategy closely — how organizations think about draft capital, contract flexibility, two-way players, and building around a franchise anchor. The tension between conventional wisdom and data-driven scouting is something I find endlessly interesting.

## Football & Soccer

Football for the scheme complexity — how coordinators adapt across a season and how a single personnel package can break a defensive structure. Soccer for the tactical side: pressing systems, positional play, and how coaching identity shows up at the squad level.
